entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I think I need to return something? I'm a bit lost with the process. The website was very confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the item or more of a preference issue?
It's the Aero Race jersey. I believe I ordered the wrong size. I finally tried it on and it's just... well, it's way too tight. I don't know what I'm supposed to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course. It sounds like you'd like to exchange it because the fit isn't right. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. It's... VF8675309.
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race jersey, delivered on October 13th. That was 69 days ago.
Oh... is that bad? I wasn't sure what the policy was.
Not at all! According to my system, our standard return policy is 90 days from the delivery date. You're well within that timeframe, so we can definitely get this return started for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! So I can send the jersey back?

Absolutely. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. You can use that to send back the jersey for a full refund. Then, you can place a new order for the size that will work better for you.
That's wonderful! Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
